meta.description: Round two investigated all 37 properties. Claim-level records distinguish direct and secondary sources, inferences, estimates and unresolved attempts. Both qualified lists retain all evidence and investment gates.
limitations: No property has verified site rights, utility capacity, a complete installed-cost quote or measured paying demand.
Scenario paybacks are conditional stress calculations, not forecasts. State commercial electricity averages are not EV tariffs.
Straight-line distances do not establish driving routes, traffic or charging demand.
Nearby candidates may be alternatives. Their demand cannot be added without diversion analysis.
The same-date frozen AFDC inventory was reused with recorded provenance; it is not a live charging test.
Some coordinates remain street-interpolated or secondary; no proposed stall layout is approved.
meta.sourceStatus: Public supporting evidence expanded; no enforceable site rights, spare capacity, complete EPC quote or measured paid demand established.

zh.description: 第二轮调查全部37处物业。逐条区分直接/次级来源、推断、估算及未查实记录；两个正式榜单保持全部证据和投资门槛。
limitations: 未取得任何物业的场地控制权、电力容量确认、完整安装报价或实测付费需求。

直线距离不是驾车路线、车流或充电需求。

finding.en: The operator offers RV-outlet EV charging, expressly says it has no dedicated EV chargers, and limits short stops to unreserved RV spaces, 08:00–20:00, $10 per two hours.

checks.verificationMethod: Opened primary operator page and read EV facilities and short-term charging conditions.
checks.nextEvidence: Parcel identifier, surveyed stalls/entrance and authority to grant charging rights.
checks.significance: Not evidence of public DCFC capability, signed land control or measured charging sales.

finding.en: Nearest AFDC E record: RMP Ivie Creek (Salina, UT) (id 387120), 46.707 straight-line miles, 4 DC ports, record last confirmed 2026-10-29. Nearest non-open community record: Torrey, UT, PLAN, 38.297 miles. These are database observations, not a field test.
finding.zh: 已重读冻结 E/P/T 和社区快照：最近 E 记录 387120，直线 46.707 英里；最近社区非开放记录为 PLAN。仅验证数据库记录。

checks.verificationMethod: Parsed both full AFDC snapshots and community snapshot locally; hashes matched provenance; recomputed haversine distances; inspected nearest rows and all records within 0.25 miles.
checks.nextEvidence: Operator uptime/access/price, permit and energization status, route distances and competitor utilization.
checks.significance: Neither no close match nor low station count proves a vacant parcel or unmet demand.

finding.en: No signed site-control document is present in the reviewed candidate dossier or opened public evidence. Retail operation does not establish charger rights.
finding.zh: 已阅材料无签署场地控制、车位、设备区、通行和租期文件。

checks.verificationMethod: Inspected supplied candidate facts/unknowns and opened primary evidence; no private title search or owner negotiation was performed.
checks.nextEvidence: Owner/landlord authorization, parcel/title and existing charging agreements; rent, term, termination and access rights.
checks.significance: Hard gate fails until evidenced; especially material where tribal or shopping-center rights apply.

finding.en: No site-specific utility capacity letter, connection study, service design, tariff eligibility confirmation or binding upgrade quote was supplied or found in the reviewed material.
finding.zh: 缺本址容量函、接网设计、费用、交期和适用费率确认。

checks.verificationMethod: Evidence inventory review; public business pages and supply snapshots are not connection studies. No utility application or contact made.
checks.nextEvidence: Serving utility confirmation; capacity/load study, transformer/feeder work, deposits, tariff and schedule.
checks.significance: A generic tariff or existing store supply cannot satisfy capacity or connection-cost gates.

finding.en: No parcel-specific Tesla/EPC quotation, civil/electrical design, contingency, commissioning or ongoing service terms are in the reviewed evidence.
finding.zh: 缺本址设备和施工总报价、设计、预备费、投用和服务条款。

checks.verificationMethod: Reviewed supplied retained public-source research and current candidate dossier for quote evidence; historical project costs and marketing estimators are excluded.
checks.nextEvidence: Scoped equipment/EPC quotes including civil work, interconnection, tax, maintenance, insurance and schedule.
checks.significance: Payback cannot be an investment-grade result without documented project costs.

finding.en: No current permit dossier, final inspection, approved stall layout or parcel-specific environmental/engineering clearance is established in the reviewed evidence.
finding.zh: 当前充电许可、验收、停车无障碍布局及地块工程限制尚未证实。

checks.verificationMethod: Public-evidence inventory only; no exhaustive municipal search is claimed. Site-specific exceptions and attempted sources are logged below.
checks.nextEvidence: Current case-level permit record and approved layout; environmental, drainage, access and legal review where applicable.
checks.significance: An absent search hit is not permit clearance; historical approval is not current operational status.

finding.en: No observed site charging sessions/kWh, realized price, queue/diversion study, route EV counts or defensible site capture evidence is available. City registration totals and amenity pages are contextual only.
finding.zh: 缺实测充电销量、成交价、排队/分流、过路 EV 和本址捕获率。

checks.verificationMethod: Reviewed current candidate evidence and frozen supply records; did not convert city EV totals or straight-line gaps into sales.
checks.nextEvidence: Measured representative seasonal demand and competing-site utilization/access, with conservative capture and willingness-to-pay evidence.
checks.significance: Hard gate blocks both network and investor lists, even when a network gap is plausible.

finding.en: A site-specific credible payback is not computable from the reviewed evidence: land, utility, quotes and measured demand are missing. No hurdle pass, profitable outcome or economic failure is established.
finding.zh: 场地、电力、报价及实测需求缺失，不能证明达到回本门槛，也不能据此断言必亏。

checks.verificationMethod: Applied evidence hard gate before scenario ranking; illustrative assumptions are not treated as measured payback.
checks.nextEvidence: Documented cost/revenue inputs, full tariff cash flow, conservative volume, financing/tax assumptions and explicit user-selected hurdle.
checks.significance: Pending; no quota filling and no elimination merely for missing evidence.

finding.en: The official page disproves a no-charging description: RV charging already exists with access restrictions. It does not prove DCFC saturation or adequate electrical capacity.
finding.zh: “无充电服务”叙述不成立：已有受限 RV 插座；仍不能推出 DCFC 饱和或容量充足。

checks.verificationMethod: Read official EV-camping page conditions.
checks.nextEvidence: Dedicated DCFC site plan, utility study and paid-demand observations.
checks.significance: Correct scope to an incremental DCFC proposal; keep site pending rather than eliminate.

reason.en: Required land-control, utility, engineering quote and demand evidence remain missing; investment payback not proven.
reason.zh: 场地控制、电力、工程报价及实测需求均未齐；投资回本未证实，不为凑十个上榜。

attemptedSources.result: Read relevant primary text this round

note.en: EIA commercial revenue/sales average includes demand and fixed charges. This is not an EV tariff or parcel eligibility confirmation.
note.zh: EIA商业电费收入/售电量均值已含需量及固定费；不是EV专用费率，也未确认本地块适用。

note.en: Chosen sensitivity factors, not measured EV bill multipliers. Actual low-utilization bills may be higher. No separate demand charge is added.
note.zh: 人为敏感性参数，不是实测EV电费倍数；低利用率实际账单可能更高，不再单加需量费。

note.en: One supplier example: $500k hardware + 8 × $55k medium installation. Added 35/20/10% allowances are not scoped grid, land, tax or EPC quotes and may be insufficient.
note.zh: 供应商单一示例：硬件50万美元+8×5.5万美元中等安装。35/20/10%预留不是接网、土地、税费或工程报价，可能不足。

note.en: Shared stress inputs. No site demand, capture rate or local achieved volume has been measured. City EV counts are not converted into sales.
note.zh: 共用压力输入，尚无本站需求、捕获率或实际销量；没有把城市EV数量换算成收入。

note.en: Chosen prices, not local observations. Discounts, fleet contracts, taxes and willingness to pay require evidence.
note.zh: 人为设置，非本地成交观察；折扣、车队合同、税和支付意愿均待核。

note.en: Supplier illustration, not a contract. Verify included maintenance, payment processing and the billed energy boundary; do not duplicate covered costs.
note.zh: 供应商示例，非合同。须核维护、支付处理及计量边界，已覆盖费用不得重复计入。

note.en: Unverified lease/insurance/admin/site-cost envelopes. The same monthly allowance is charged during construction; holding-cost NPV is timed at the construction midpoint. No utility fixed charge is separately added to the all-in proxy.
note.zh: 租金/保险/管理/现场成本包尚未验证；建设期也扣同额月费，持有成本按建设中点折现。综合电价代理外不另加电力固定费。

valueOrRange.en: 2% / 1.5% / 1% of initial capex each operating year

note.en: A conservative normalized cash deduction for excluded site assets, not a known maintenance contract or predicted replacement schedule. Reconcile with Tesla coverage before admission.
note.zh: 未覆盖现场资产的标准化现金扣减，非已知维护合同或预测更新计划；入选前须与Tesla服务范围核对。

note.en: No utility/EPC schedule is confirmed. No charging revenue before commissioning. Fixed costs are not reduced by the first-year volume ramp.
note.zh: 尚无电力/工程交期确认，投用前无充电收入；固定成本不随首年销量爬坡同比下降。

note.en: 22kWh is an analogue-informed downside assumption from a 2020–2023 paid non-Tesla DCFC sample, not a local measurement or calibrated percentile. Base/optimistic 40kWh and losses remain assumptions. Grid purchase = billed charger output/(1-loss).
note.zh: 22kWh依据2020–2023年非Tesla付费快充样本设置下行假设，非本地实测或统计分位数。基准/乐观40kWh及损耗仍是假设；购电=充电器计费输出/(1-损耗)。

valueOrRange.en: 10 operating years; 10% real; no growth, subsidy or terminal value
valueOrRange.zh: 10个运营年；10%实际折现率；零增长/补贴/残值

note.en: Chosen screening policy. NREL provides a historical 10-year EVSE modeling precedent, not a V4 life guarantee. A shorter enforceable tenure must shorten the horizon.
note.zh: 选定的筛选规则；NREL历史模型采用10年，但不是V4寿命保证；可执行租期更短时须缩短模型期限。

reason.en: The reference scenarios fail one or more hard payback/NPV/downside-cash tests. This is a failure of the stated assumptions, not proof that the actual parcel must lose money.
reason.zh: 参照情景未通过至少一项回本/NPV/保守现金门槛；这说明该组假设不达标，并非证明真实物业必亏。

note.en: Electricity is conditioned only on the Utah commercial-state benchmark. Same-state results are intentionally identical where no verified property-specific inputs exist. These are conditional calculations for a third-party charging-revenue owner, not Tesla's network costs or host-rent returns.
note.zh: 电价仅按Utah州商业统计作地域条件。在缺少物业独有实测参数时，同州结果有意保持一致，不虚构差异。这是第三方拥有充电收入的条件测算，不代表Tesla内部成本或场地主租金收益。

changeReason.en: Conservative session energy is reduced from 40 to 22 kWh using an older non-Tesla paid-session analogue as a downside assumption. Base and optimistic inputs are unchanged where no defensible site-specific replacement exists. Public tariff sensitivities below are separate incomplete-bill tests.
changeReason.zh: 保守单次电量由40降至22kWh，以较早非Tesla付费样本作下行假设。没有可靠逐址替代值时基准与乐观输入保留。下方公开费率敏感性单独计算，非完整账单。

note.en: EVgo reported 276 kWh/stall/day for its owned public network in Q2 2026. A network-wide average is neither a local demand forecast nor an upper bound. The required volume keeps price and the all-in electricity proxy fixed, so it is a mechanical hurdle test.
note.zh: EVgo报告2026Q2自营公共网络276kWh/枪/日。网络均值不是本站需求预测或上限。门槛销量计算保持售价及综合电费代理不变，仅为数学条件测试。

claim.en: Garkane publishes a Utah three-phase EV schedule above 50kVA with separate peak/off-peak charges. Linked PDF dates conflict with its 2026 rate landing page; minimum-charge wording is also inconsistent.
claim.zh: Garkane公布犹他州三相、超过50kVA充电负荷的分时费率；PDF日期与2026主页冲突，最低收费表述也不一致。

limitation.en: Not confirmed as Duke’s applicable current rate. Do not combine demand charges or select a lower minimum without clarification.
limitation.zh: 未确认是Duke’s现行适用费率；不可自行合并需量费或选较低最低收费。

claim.en: Line-extension policy requires the permanent-service applicant to prepay estimated extension costs and bear specified easement, permitting and civil-work costs.
claim.zh: 线路延伸政策要求永久供电申请人预付估算工程费，并承担规定的地役权、许可及土建成本。

limitation.en: Cost-allocation policy, not parcel capacity or project quote; last revision 2020.
limitation.zh: 这是成本分配政策，不是地块容量或报价；修订于2020年。

remainingCritical.en: Executed charger lease/easements, signatory authority, exclusivity and 24-hour public-access rights remain unverified.
remainingCritical.zh: 充电租约、地役权、签署权限、排他条款及24小时公众通行权未核实。

remainingCritical.en: No parcel-specific firm capacity, connection scope/date or utility construction quote was obtained.
remainingCritical.zh: 未取得地块级确定容量、接入范围/日期或供电施工报价。

remainingCritical.en: Final engineering, permit clearance, complete EPC cost and lifecycle operating terms remain unverified.
remainingCritical.zh: 最终设计、许可、完整EPC造价及全生命周期运营条款未核实。

remainingCritical.en: No observed site charging revenue/utilization or defensible traffic-to-session conversion was obtained.
remainingCritical.zh: 未取得场地实测充电收入/利用率或可验证车流转充电次数关系。

changesToPrior.en: Added actual tariff and construction-cost allocation; prior RV-outlet evidence unchanged.
changesToPrior.zh: 新增实际费率及接入成本责任，原房车插座证据不变。

publicResearchConclusion.en: Concrete connection-cost constraints now exist, but tariff conflicts and parcel execution gates remain unresolved. No qualification upgrade.
publicResearchConclusion.zh: 接入成本约束更明确，但费率冲突及地块执行门槛未解决，不提升合格状态。

attempts.result: Primary sources opened; ambiguities retained.
No executed rights, capacity letter or site-matched measured charging demand obtained.

zh.type: 条件新址候选

facts.claim: 业主确认631 West Main St，每日7:00–21:00营业。
美国国家公园管理局说明化石遗址各区域相距1–2小时车程，建议预先规划燃油或充电。
Tesla 确认 Hines 的 Grocery Outlet（629 North US20）有8个最高250kW超充位、全天开放。

finding.en: Operator lists 631 West Main St and daily 07:00–21:00.
finding.zh: 业主确认 631 West Main St，营业 07:00–21:00。

checks.verificationMethod: Opened operator page, address and store-hours section.
checks.nextEvidence: Parcel identifier, surveyed stalls/entrance and authority to grant charging rights.
checks.significance: Store hours do not establish 24-hour charging or restroom rights.

finding.en: Nearest AFDC E record: OTEC JOHN DAY (id 183737), 0.59 straight-line miles, 1 DC ports, record last confirmed 2026-10-29. Nearest non-open community record: Pendleton, OR - SW 20th St, PLAN, 86.436 miles. These are database observations, not a field test.
finding.zh: 已重读冻结 E/P/T 和社区快照：最近 E 记录 183737，直线 0.59 英里；最近社区非开放记录为 PLAN。仅验证数据库记录。

checks.verificationMethod: Parsed both full AFDC snapshots and community snapshot locally; hashes matched provenance; recomputed haversine distances; inspected nearest rows and all records within 0.25 miles.
checks.nextEvidence: Operator uptime/access/price, permit and energization status, route distances and competitor utilization.
checks.significance: Neither no close match nor low station count proves a vacant parcel or unmet demand.

finding.en: No signed site-control document is present in the reviewed candidate dossier or opened public evidence. Retail operation does not establish charger rights.
finding.zh: 已阅材料无签署场地控制、车位、设备区、通行和租期文件。

checks.verificationMethod: Inspected supplied candidate facts/unknowns and opened primary evidence; no private title search or owner negotiation was performed.
checks.nextEvidence: Owner/landlord authorization, parcel/title and existing charging agreements; rent, term, termination and access rights.
checks.significance: Hard gate fails until evidenced; especially material where tribal or shopping-center rights apply.

finding.en: No site-specific utility capacity letter, connection study, service design, tariff eligibility confirmation or binding upgrade quote was supplied or found in the reviewed material.
finding.zh: 缺本址容量函、接网设计、费用、交期和适用费率确认。

checks.verificationMethod: Evidence inventory review; public business pages and supply snapshots are not connection studies. No utility application or contact made.
checks.nextEvidence: Serving utility confirmation; capacity/load study, transformer/feeder work, deposits, tariff and schedule.
checks.significance: A generic tariff or existing store supply cannot satisfy capacity or connection-cost gates.

finding.en: No parcel-specific Tesla/EPC quotation, civil/electrical design, contingency, commissioning or ongoing service terms are in the reviewed evidence.
finding.zh: 缺本址设备和施工总报价、设计、预备费、投用和服务条款。

checks.verificationMethod: Reviewed supplied retained public-source research and current candidate dossier for quote evidence; historical project costs and marketing estimators are excluded.
checks.nextEvidence: Scoped equipment/EPC quotes including civil work, interconnection, tax, maintenance, insurance and schedule.
checks.significance: Payback cannot be an investment-grade result without documented project costs.

finding.en: No current permit dossier, final inspection, approved stall layout or parcel-specific environmental/engineering clearance is established in the reviewed evidence.
finding.zh: 当前充电许可、验收、停车无障碍布局及地块工程限制尚未证实。

checks.verificationMethod: Public-evidence inventory only; no exhaustive municipal search is claimed. Site-specific exceptions and attempted sources are logged below.
checks.nextEvidence: Current case-level permit record and approved layout; environmental, drainage, access and legal review where applicable.
checks.significance: An absent search hit is not permit clearance; historical approval is not current operational status.

finding.en: No observed site charging sessions/kWh, realized price, queue/diversion study, route EV counts or defensible site capture evidence is available. City registration totals and amenity pages are contextual only.
finding.zh: 缺实测充电销量、成交价、排队/分流、过路 EV 和本址捕获率。

checks.verificationMethod: Reviewed current candidate evidence and frozen supply records; did not convert city EV totals or straight-line gaps into sales.
checks.nextEvidence: Measured representative seasonal demand and competing-site utilization/access, with conservative capture and willingness-to-pay evidence.
checks.significance: Hard gate blocks both network and investor lists, even when a network gap is plausible.

finding.en: A site-specific credible payback is not computable from the reviewed evidence: land, utility, quotes and measured demand are missing. No hurdle pass, profitable outcome or economic failure is established.
finding.zh: 场地、电力、报价及实测需求缺失，不能证明达到回本门槛，也不能据此断言必亏。

checks.verificationMethod: Applied evidence hard gate before scenario ranking; illustrative assumptions are not treated as measured payback.
checks.nextEvidence: Documented cost/revenue inputs, full tariff cash flow, conservative volume, financing/tax assumptions and explicit user-selected hurdle.
checks.significance: Pending; no quota filling and no elimination merely for missing evidence.

reason.en: Required land-control, utility, engineering quote and demand evidence remain missing; investment payback not proven.
reason.zh: 场地控制、电力、工程报价及实测需求均未齐；投资回本未证实，不为凑十个上榜。

attemptedSources.result: Read relevant primary text this round

note.en: EIA commercial revenue/sales average includes demand and fixed charges. This is not an EV tariff or parcel eligibility confirmation.
note.zh: EIA商业电费收入/售电量均值已含需量及固定费；不是EV专用费率，也未确认本地块适用。

note.en: Chosen sensitivity factors, not measured EV bill multipliers. Actual low-utilization bills may be higher. No separate demand charge is added.
note.zh: 人为敏感性参数，不是实测EV电费倍数；低利用率实际账单可能更高，不再单加需量费。

note.en: One supplier example: $500k hardware + 8 × $55k medium installation. Added 35/20/10% allowances are not scoped grid, land, tax or EPC quotes and may be insufficient.
note.zh: 供应商单一示例：硬件50万美元+8×5.5万美元中等安装。35/20/10%预留不是接网、土地、税费或工程报价，可能不足。

note.en: Shared stress inputs. No site demand, capture rate or local achieved volume has been measured. City EV counts are not converted into sales.
note.zh: 共用压力输入，尚无本站需求、捕获率或实际销量；没有把城市EV数量换算成收入。

note.en: Chosen prices, not local observations. Discounts, fleet contracts, taxes and willingness to pay require evidence.
note.zh: 人为设置，非本地成交观察；折扣、车队合同、税和支付意愿均待核。

note.en: Supplier illustration, not a contract. Verify included maintenance, payment processing and the billed energy boundary; do not duplicate covered costs.
note.zh: 供应商示例，非合同。须核维护、支付处理及计量边界，已覆盖费用不得重复计入。

note.en: Unverified lease/insurance/admin/site-cost envelopes. The same monthly allowance is charged during construction; holding-cost NPV is timed at the construction midpoint. No utility fixed charge is separately added to the all-in proxy.
note.zh: 租金/保险/管理/现场成本包尚未验证；建设期也扣同额月费，持有成本按建设中点折现。综合电价代理外不另加电力固定费。

valueOrRange.en: 2% / 1.5% / 1% of initial capex each operating year

note.en: A conservative normalized cash deduction for excluded site assets, not a known maintenance contract or predicted replacement schedule. Reconcile with Tesla coverage before admission.
note.zh: 未覆盖现场资产的标准化现金扣减，非已知维护合同或预测更新计划；入选前须与Tesla服务范围核对。

note.en: No utility/EPC schedule is confirmed. No charging revenue before commissioning. Fixed costs are not reduced by the first-year volume ramp.
note.zh: 尚无电力/工程交期确认，投用前无充电收入；固定成本不随首年销量爬坡同比下降。

note.en: 22kWh is an analogue-informed downside assumption from a 2020–2023 paid non-Tesla DCFC sample, not a local measurement or calibrated percentile. Base/optimistic 40kWh and losses remain assumptions. Grid purchase = billed charger output/(1-loss).
note.zh: 22kWh依据2020–2023年非Tesla付费快充样本设置下行假设，非本地实测或统计分位数。基准/乐观40kWh及损耗仍是假设；购电=充电器计费输出/(1-损耗)。

valueOrRange.en: 10 operating years; 10% real; no growth, subsidy or terminal value
valueOrRange.zh: 10个运营年；10%实际折现率；零增长/补贴/残值

note.en: Chosen screening policy. NREL provides a historical 10-year EVSE modeling precedent, not a V4 life guarantee. A shorter enforceable tenure must shorten the horizon.
note.zh: 选定的筛选规则；NREL历史模型采用10年，但不是V4寿命保证；可执行租期更短时须缩短模型期限。

reason.en: The reference scenarios fail one or more hard payback/NPV/downside-cash tests. This is a failure of the stated assumptions, not proof that the actual parcel must lose money.
reason.zh: 参照情景未通过至少一项回本/NPV/保守现金门槛；这说明该组假设不达标，并非证明真实物业必亏。

note.en: Electricity is conditioned only on the Oregon commercial-state benchmark. Same-state results are intentionally identical where no verified property-specific inputs exist. These are conditional calculations for a third-party charging-revenue owner, not Tesla's network costs or host-rent returns.
note.zh: 电价仅按Oregon州商业统计作地域条件。在缺少物业独有实测参数时，同州结果有意保持一致，不虚构差异。这是第三方拥有充电收入的条件测算，不代表Tesla内部成本或场地主租金收益。

changeReason.en: Conservative session energy is reduced from 40 to 22 kWh using an older non-Tesla paid-session analogue as a downside assumption. Base and optimistic inputs are unchanged where no defensible site-specific replacement exists. Public tariff sensitivities below are separate incomplete-bill tests.
changeReason.zh: 保守单次电量由40降至22kWh，以较早非Tesla付费样本作下行假设。没有可靠逐址替代值时基准与乐观输入保留。下方公开费率敏感性单独计算，非完整账单。

note.en: EVgo reported 276 kWh/stall/day for its owned public network in Q2 2026. A network-wide average is neither a local demand forecast nor an upper bound. The required volume keeps price and the all-in electricity proxy fixed, so it is a mechanical hurdle test.
note.zh: EVgo报告2026Q2自营公共网络276kWh/枪/日。网络均值不是本站需求预测或上限。门槛销量计算保持售价及综合电费代理不变，仅为数学条件测试。

claim.en: OTEC lists Chester’s Thriftway at631 West Main as a payment station.
claim.zh: OTEC将631WestMain的Chester’sThriftway列为缴费网点。

limitation.en: Relationship does not verify candidate meter, charger consent or spare capacity.
limitation.zh: 业务关系不证明候选地电表、充电许可或余量。

claim.en: G3 is an EV-specific tariff for service above 50 and below 1000kVA, with EV-majority load and adequate adjacent facilities without new upstream facilities.
claim.zh: G3是大于50且小于1000kVA、充电占主要负荷且邻近设施充足、无需新上游设施的专用充电费率。

limitation.en: PCA and taxes unquantified; eligibility/load unverified. G4 is OTEC-owned retail charging, not electricity purchase cost.
limitation.zh: PCA及税未量化，适用资格与负荷未核实；G4是OTEC自营零售充电价。

remainingCritical.en: Executed charger lease/easements, signatory authority, exclusivity and 24-hour public-access rights remain unverified.
remainingCritical.zh: 充电租约、地役权、签署权限、排他条款及24小时公众通行权未核实。

remainingCritical.en: No parcel-specific firm capacity, connection scope/date or utility construction quote was obtained.
remainingCritical.zh: 未取得地块级确定容量、接入范围/日期或供电施工报价。

remainingCritical.en: Final engineering, permit clearance, complete EPC cost and lifecycle operating terms remain unverified.
remainingCritical.zh: 最终设计、许可、完整EPC造价及全生命周期运营条款未核实。

remainingCritical.en: No observed site charging revenue/utilization or defensible traffic-to-session conversion was obtained.
remainingCritical.zh: 未取得场地实测充电收入/利用率或可验证车流转充电次数关系。

changesToPrior.en: Added dated G3 components and explicit transformer minimum.
changesToPrior.zh: 新增有日期G3分项费用及变压器最低收费。

publicResearchConclusion.en: Supports conditional published-charge sensitivity only. The 1000kVA cutoff must constrain scenarios; no investment qualification.
publicResearchConclusion.zh: 仅支持有条件公开费用敏感性测算，须遵守1000kVA边界，不能认定投资合格。

note.zh: 供应商单一示例：硬件50万美元+8×5.5万美元中等安装。35/20/10%预留不是接网、土地、税费或工程报价，可能不足。

note.en: Shared stress inputs. No site demand, capture rate or local achieved volume has been measured. City EV counts are not converted into sales.
note.zh: 共用压力输入，尚无本站需求、捕获率或实际销量；没有把城市EV数量换算成收入。

note.en: Chosen prices, not local observations. Discounts, fleet contracts, taxes and willingness to pay require evidence.
note.zh: 人为设置，非本地成交观察；折扣、车队合同、税和支付意愿均待核。

note.en: Supplier illustration, not a contract. Verify included maintenance, payment processing and the billed energy boundary; do not duplicate covered costs.
note.zh: 供应商示例，非合同。须核维护、支付处理及计量边界，已覆盖费用不得重复计入。

note.en: Unverified lease/insurance/admin/site-cost envelopes. The same monthly allowance is charged during construction; holding-cost NPV is timed at the construction midpoint. No utility fixed charge is separately added to the all-in proxy.
note.zh: 租金/保险/管理/现场成本包尚未验证；建设期也扣同额月费，持有成本按建设中点折现。综合电价代理外不另加电力固定费。

valueOrRange.en: 2% / 1.5% / 1% of initial capex each operating year

note.en: A conservative normalized cash deduction for excluded site assets, not a known maintenance contract or predicted replacement schedule. Reconcile with Tesla coverage before admission.
note.zh: 未覆盖现场资产的标准化现金扣减，非已知维护合同或预测更新计划；入选前须与Tesla服务范围核对。

note.en: No utility/EPC schedule is confirmed. No charging revenue before commissioning. Fixed costs are not reduced by the first-year volume ramp.
note.zh: 尚无电力/工程交期确认，投用前无充电收入；固定成本不随首年销量爬坡同比下降。

note.en: 22kWh is an analogue-informed downside assumption from a 2020–2023 paid non-Tesla DCFC sample, not a local measurement or calibrated percentile. Base/optimistic 40kWh and losses remain assumptions. Grid purchase = billed charger output/(1-loss).
note.zh: 22kWh依据2020–2023年非Tesla付费快充样本设置下行假设，非本地实测或统计分位数。基准/乐观40kWh及损耗仍是假设；购电=充电器计费输出/(1-损耗)。

valueOrRange.en: 10 operating years; 10% real; no growth, subsidy or terminal value
valueOrRange.zh: 10个运营年；10%实际折现率；零增长/补贴/残值

note.en: Chosen screening policy. NREL provides a historical 10-year EVSE modeling precedent, not a V4 life guarantee. A shorter enforceable tenure must shorten the horizon.
note.zh: 选定的筛选规则；NREL历史模型采用10年，但不是V4寿命保证；可执行租期更短时须缩短模型期限。

reason.en: The reference scenarios fail one or more hard payback/NPV/downside-cash tests. This is a failure of the stated assumptions, not proof that the actual parcel must lose money.
reason.zh: 参照情景未通过至少一项回本/NPV/保守现金门槛；这说明该组假设不达标，并非证明真实物业必亏。

note.en: Electricity is conditioned only on the Idaho commercial-state benchmark. Same-state results are intentionally identical where no verified property-specific inputs exist. These are conditional calculations for a third-party charging-revenue owner, not Tesla's network costs or host-rent returns.
note.zh: 电价仅按Idaho州商业统计作地域条件。在缺少物业独有实测参数时，同州结果有意保持一致，不虚构差异。这是第三方拥有充电收入的条件测算，不代表Tesla内部成本或场地主租金收益。

changeReason.en: Conservative session energy is reduced from 40 to 22 kWh using an older non-Tesla paid-session analogue as a downside assumption. Base and optimistic inputs are unchanged where no defensible site-specific replacement exists. Public tariff sensitivities below are separate incomplete-bill tests.
changeReason.zh: 保守单次电量由40降至22kWh，以较早非Tesla付费样本作下行假设。没有可靠逐址替代值时基准与乐观输入保留。下方公开费率敏感性单独计算，非完整账单。

note.en: EVgo reported 276 kWh/stall/day for its owned public network in Q2 2026. A network-wide average is neither a local demand forecast nor an upper bound. The required volume keeps price and the all-in electricity proxy fixed, so it is a mechanical hurdle test.
note.zh: EVgo报告2026Q2自营公共网络276kWh/枪/日。网络均值不是本站需求预测或上限。门槛销量计算保持售价及综合电费代理不变，仅为数学条件测试。

claim.en: Owner history says the old Main Street lease ended, the business built the US93 store opening 1998, and founding ownership continued with later-generation management.
claim.zh: 经营者自述旧主街租约结束后建造US93新店，1998年开业，创办方保有经营所有权、后代管理。

limitation.en: Business history is not current real-estate title or charger lease; alternate map/address discrepancy remains.
limitation.zh: 经营历史不是当前不动产权属或充电租约，替代地图位置差异仍待解决。

claim.en: Idaho’s utility directory links Salmon River Electric; the chamber identifies its Challis office and Custer/Lemhi service area.
claim.zh: 爱达荷州目录收录SalmonRiverElectric，商会列其Challis办公室及Custer/Lemhi服务区域。

limitation.en: Does not prove parcel meter utility or capacity; current usable tariff unavailable.
limitation.zh: 不证明地块电表供电方或容量，未取得可用当前费率。

remainingCritical.en: Executed charger lease/easements, signatory authority, exclusivity and 24-hour public-access rights remain unverified.
remainingCritical.zh: 充电租约、地役权、签署权限、排他条款及24小时公众通行权未核实。

remainingCritical.en: No parcel-specific firm capacity, connection scope/date or utility construction quote was obtained.
remainingCritical.zh: 未取得地块级确定容量、接入范围/日期或供电施工报价。

remainingCritical.en: Final engineering, permit clearance, complete EPC cost and lifecycle operating terms remain unverified.
remainingCritical.zh: 最终设计、许可、完整EPC造价及全生命周期运营条款未核实。

remainingCritical.en: No observed site charging revenue/utilization or defensible traffic-to-session conversion was obtained.
remainingCritical.zh: 未取得场地实测充电收入/利用率或可验证车流转充电次数关系。

changesToPrior.en: Added owner history and targeted utility route; no numeric rate substitution.
changesToPrior.zh: 新增经营者历史及明确供电调查对象，不替换数值费率。

publicResearchConclusion.en: Questions are more targeted; no critical execution gate closed.
publicResearchConclusion.zh: 调查问题更聚焦，关键执行门槛未关闭。

thesis.investor: No verified project economics; excluded from the qualified investment list.

killCriteria: Existing or imminent supply removes the supported incremental value.
Connection, construction or property costs fail the investment policy.
No enforceable site rights or compliant parking/access layout
Measured demand does not support the stated objective.
unknowns: Written utility capacity, connection cost and delivery schedule
Owner/tenant consent, parking rights, lease term and exclusivity
Round-the-clock charging/restrooms, accessibility and entrances
Actual charging demand, realized price and contractual fees
Local permits, drainage/flood exposure and physical layout

facts.claim: County identifies Raine’s at 901 N Main with grocery/deli/hardware and 24-hour fuel; this does not mean 24-hour indoor amenities.
Official tourism confirms address and food amenities; directions link encodes 39.5325005,-115.9705138.
Tesla lists Ely, NV with 8 Superchargers, up to 325 kW, available 24/7.

rankRationale.network: Historical research order only. US-50 grocery, food and fuel node; investigate incremental Tesla corridor coverage.
rankRationale.investor: Requires the same evidence and payback gates as every other property.

thesis.network: US-50 长距离走廊的餐饮、杂货及燃油节点，优先核实 Tesla 网络补点价值。
thesis.investor: 未形成足够投资证据，不进入正式投资名单。

zh.counterargument: 附近已有 Wagon Trail Storage 的两口 50kW DCFC 记录，确认日期较旧。新增高功率供给是否有价值仍待验证；不能据此声称已有排队或需求溢出。
unknowns: 电力公司书面接网容量、费用和交期
业主/租户许可、停车位、租期及排他合作
全天充电与卫生间开放、无障碍及出入口
实际充电需求、成交电价和合同费用
地方许可、排水/洪涝及现场布置
killCriteria: 现有或即将上线供给消除了可解释的增量价值
接网、施工或场地费用超出可接受条件
无法取得场地使用权或合规的停车/出入口布局
实测需求不能支持该视角的推进目标
zh.coordinateQuality: 官方旅游资料关联的Google商户标记，不是地块边界

rankRationale.network: 历史研究顺序，仅供审计，不代表当前通过筛选。 已筛物业中，长距离网络缺口与明确服务节点的结合较强；低交通量和接网成本可能推翻这一优先级。
rankRationale.investor: 须通过统一证据与回本门槛。

zh.type: 条件新址候选

facts.claim: 县政府列明 Raine’s 位于901 N Main，提供杂货、熟食、五金和24小时加油；室内设施不因此保证全天开放。
官方旅游页面确认地址和餐饮，导航链接编码坐标39.5325005,-115.9705138。
Tesla 列明 Ely 有8个超充位、最高325kW、全天开放。

finding.en: County lists the market at 901 N Main St and describes 24-hour fuel.
finding.zh: 县政府列明 901 N Main St，并说明加油服务全天开放。

checks.verificationMethod: Opened county business entry and read address and fuel description.
checks.nextEvidence: Parcel identifier, surveyed stalls/entrance and authority to grant charging rights.
checks.significance: 24-hour fuel does not establish 24-hour indoor amenities or parking rights.

finding.en: Nearest AFDC E record: Wagon Trail Storage (id 440890), 1.55 straight-line miles, 2 DC ports, record last confirmed 2025-12-12. Nearest non-open community record: Alamo, NV, VOTING, 149.06 miles. These are database observations, not a field test.
finding.zh: 已重读冻结 E/P/T 和社区快照：最近 E 记录 440890，直线 1.55 英里；最近社区非开放记录为 VOTING。仅验证数据库记录。

checks.verificationMethod: Parsed both full AFDC snapshots and community snapshot locally; hashes matched provenance; recomputed haversine distances; inspected nearest rows and all records within 0.25 miles.
checks.nextEvidence: Operator uptime/access/price, permit and energization status, route distances and competitor utilization.
checks.significance: Neither no close match nor low station count proves a vacant parcel or unmet demand.

finding.en: No signed site-control document is present in the reviewed candidate dossier or opened public evidence. Retail operation does not establish charger rights.
finding.zh: 已阅材料无签署场地控制、车位、设备区、通行和租期文件。

checks.verificationMethod: Inspected supplied candidate facts/unknowns and opened primary evidence; no private title search or owner negotiation was performed.
checks.nextEvidence: Owner/landlord authorization, parcel/title and existing charging agreements; rent, term, termination and access rights.
checks.significance: Hard gate fails until evidenced; especially material where tribal or shopping-center rights apply.

finding.en: No site-specific utility capacity letter, connection study, service design, tariff eligibility confirmation or binding upgrade quote was supplied or found in the reviewed material.
finding.zh: 缺本址容量函、接网设计、费用、交期和适用费率确认。

checks.verificationMethod: Evidence inventory review; public business pages and supply snapshots are not connection studies. No utility application or contact made.
checks.nextEvidence: Serving utility confirmation; capacity/load study, transformer/feeder work, deposits, tariff and schedule.
checks.significance: A generic tariff or existing store supply cannot satisfy capacity or connection-cost gates.

finding.en: No parcel-specific Tesla/EPC quotation, civil/electrical design, contingency, commissioning or ongoing service terms are in the reviewed evidence.
finding.zh: 缺本址设备和施工总报价、设计、预备费、投用和服务条款。

checks.verificationMethod: Reviewed supplied retained public-source research and current candidate dossier for quote evidence; historical project costs and marketing estimators are excluded.
checks.nextEvidence: Scoped equipment/EPC quotes including civil work, interconnection, tax, maintenance, insurance and schedule.
checks.significance: Payback cannot be an investment-grade result without documented project costs.

finding.en: No current permit dossier, final inspection, approved stall layout or parcel-specific environmental/engineering clearance is established in the reviewed evidence.
finding.zh: 当前充电许可、验收、停车无障碍布局及地块工程限制尚未证实。

checks.verificationMethod: Public-evidence inventory only; no exhaustive municipal search is claimed. Site-specific exceptions and attempted sources are logged below.
checks.nextEvidence: Current case-level permit record and approved layout; environmental, drainage, access and legal review where applicable.
checks.significance: An absent search hit is not permit clearance; historical approval is not current operational status.

finding.en: No observed site charging sessions/kWh, realized price, queue/diversion study, route EV counts or defensible site capture evidence is available. City registration totals and amenity pages are contextual only.
finding.zh: 缺实测充电销量、成交价、排队/分流、过路 EV 和本址捕获率。

checks.verificationMethod: Reviewed current candidate evidence and frozen supply records; did not convert city EV totals or straight-line gaps into sales.
checks.nextEvidence: Measured representative seasonal demand and competing-site utilization/access, with conservative capture and willingness-to-pay evidence.
checks.significance: Hard gate blocks both network and investor lists, even when a network gap is plausible.

finding.en: A site-specific credible payback is not computable from the reviewed evidence: land, utility, quotes and measured demand are missing. No hurdle pass, profitable outcome or economic failure is established.
finding.zh: 场地、电力、报价及实测需求缺失，不能证明达到回本门槛，也不能据此断言必亏。

checks.verificationMethod: Applied evidence hard gate before scenario ranking; illustrative assumptions are not treated as measured payback.
checks.nextEvidence: Documented cost/revenue inputs, full tariff cash flow, conservative volume, financing/tax assumptions and explicit user-selected hurdle.
checks.significance: Pending; no quota filling and no elimination merely for missing evidence.

reason.en: Required land-control, utility, engineering quote and demand evidence remain missing; investment payback not proven.
reason.zh: 场地控制、电力、工程报价及实测需求均未齐；投资回本未证实，不为凑十个上榜。

attemptedSources.result: Read relevant primary text this round

note.en: EIA commercial revenue/sales average includes demand and fixed charges. This is not an EV tariff or parcel eligibility confirmation.
note.zh: EIA商业电费收入/售电量均值已含需量及固定费；不是EV专用费率，也未确认本地块适用。

note.en: Chosen sensitivity factors, not measured EV bill multipliers. Actual low-utilization bills may be higher. No separate demand charge is added.
note.zh: 人为敏感性参数，不是实测EV电费倍数；低利用率实际账单可能更高，不再单加需量费。

note.en: One supplier example: $500k hardware + 8 × $55k medium installation. Added 35/20/10% allowances are not scoped grid, land, tax or EPC quotes and may be insufficient.
note.zh: 供应商单一示例：硬件50万美元+8×5.5万美元中等安装。35/20/10%预留不是接网、土地、税费或工程报价，可能不足。

note.en: Shared stress inputs. No site demand, capture rate or local achieved volume has been measured. City EV counts are not converted into sales.
note.zh: 共用压力输入，尚无本站需求、捕获率或实际销量；没有把城市EV数量换算成收入。

note.en: Chosen prices, not local observations. Discounts, fleet contracts, taxes and willingness to pay require evidence.
note.zh: 人为设置，非本地成交观察；折扣、车队合同、税和支付意愿均待核。

note.en: Supplier illustration, not a contract. Verify included maintenance, payment processing and the billed energy boundary; do not duplicate covered costs.
note.zh: 供应商示例，非合同。须核维护、支付处理及计量边界，已覆盖费用不得重复计入。

note.en: Unverified lease/insurance/admin/site-cost envelopes. The same monthly allowance is charged during construction; holding-cost NPV is timed at the construction midpoint. No utility fixed charge is separately added to the all-in proxy.
note.zh: 租金/保险/管理/现场成本包尚未验证；建设期也扣同额月费，持有成本按建设中点折现。综合电价代理外不另加电力固定费。

valueOrRange.en: 2% / 1.5% / 1% of initial capex each operating year

note.en: A conservative normalized cash deduction for excluded site assets, not a known maintenance contract or predicted replacement schedule. Reconcile with Tesla coverage before admission.
note.zh: 未覆盖现场资产的标准化现金扣减，非已知维护合同或预测更新计划；入选前须与Tesla服务范围核对。

note.en: No utility/EPC schedule is confirmed. No charging revenue before commissioning. Fixed costs are not reduced by the first-year volume ramp.
note.zh: 尚无电力/工程交期确认，投用前无充电收入；固定成本不随首年销量爬坡同比下降。

note.en: 22kWh is an analogue-informed downside assumption from a 2020–2023 paid non-Tesla DCFC sample, not a local measurement or calibrated percentile. Base/optimistic 40kWh and losses remain assumptions. Grid purchase = billed charger output/(1-loss).
note.zh: 22kWh依据2020–2023年非Tesla付费快充样本设置下行假设，非本地实测或统计分位数。基准/乐观40kWh及损耗仍是假设；购电=充电器计费输出/(1-损耗)。

valueOrRange.en: 10 operating years; 10% real; no growth, subsidy or terminal value
valueOrRange.zh: 10个运营年；10%实际折现率；零增长/补贴/残值

note.en: Chosen screening policy. NREL provides a historical 10-year EVSE modeling precedent, not a V4 life guarantee. A shorter enforceable tenure must shorten the horizon.
note.zh: 选定的筛选规则；NREL历史模型采用10年，但不是V4寿命保证；可执行租期更短时须缩短模型期限。

reason.en: The reference scenarios fail one or more hard payback/NPV/downside-cash tests. This is a failure of the stated assumptions, not proof that the actual parcel must lose money.
reason.zh: 参照情景未通过至少一项回本/NPV/保守现金门槛；这说明该组假设不达标，并非证明真实物业必亏。

note.en: Electricity is conditioned only on the New Mexico commercial-state benchmark. Same-state results are intentionally identical where no verified property-specific inputs exist. These are conditional calculations for a third-party charging-revenue owner, not Tesla's network costs or host-rent returns.
note.zh: 电价仅按New Mexico州商业统计作地域条件。在缺少物业独有实测参数时，同州结果有意保持一致，不虚构差异。这是第三方拥有充电收入的条件测算，不代表Tesla内部成本或场地主租金收益。

changeReason.en: Conservative session energy is reduced from 40 to 22 kWh using an older non-Tesla paid-session analogue as a downside assumption. Base and optimistic inputs are unchanged where no defensible site-specific replacement exists. Public tariff sensitivities below are separate incomplete-bill tests.
changeReason.zh: 保守单次电量由40降至22kWh，以较早非Tesla付费样本作下行假设。没有可靠逐址替代值时基准与乐观输入保留。下方公开费率敏感性单独计算，非完整账单。

note.en: EVgo reported 276 kWh/stall/day for its owned public network in Q2 2026. A network-wide average is neither a local demand forecast nor an upper bound. The required volume keeps price and the all-in electricity proxy fixed, so it is a mechanical hurdle test.
note.zh: EVgo报告2026Q2自营公共网络276kWh/枪/日。网络均值不是本站需求预测或上限。门槛销量计算保持售价及综合电费代理不变，仅为数学条件测试。

claim.en: NORA maintains a Chama office, identifying a concrete utility inquiry route.
claim.zh: NORA在Chama设办公室，提供明确供电调查对象。

limitation.en: Does not confirm Lowe’s meter or available capacity.
limitation.zh: 不确认Lowe’s电表或可用容量。

note.en: EIA commercial revenue/sales average includes demand and fixed charges. This is not an EV tariff or parcel eligibility confirmation.

note.en: Chosen sensitivity factors, not measured EV bill multipliers. Actual low-utilization bills may be higher. No separate demand charge is added.
note.zh: 人为敏感性参数，不是实测EV电费倍数；低利用率实际账单可能更高，不再单加需量费。

note.en: One supplier example: $500k hardware + 8 × $55k medium installation. Added 35/20/10% allowances are not scoped grid, land, tax or EPC quotes and may be insufficient.
note.zh: 供应商单一示例：硬件50万美元+8×5.5万美元中等安装。35/20/10%预留不是接网、土地、税费或工程报价，可能不足。

note.en: Shared stress inputs. No site demand, capture rate or local achieved volume has been measured. City EV counts are not converted into sales.
note.zh: 共用压力输入，尚无本站需求、捕获率或实际销量；没有把城市EV数量换算成收入。

note.en: Chosen prices, not local observations. Discounts, fleet contracts, taxes and willingness to pay require evidence.
note.zh: 人为设置，非本地成交观察；折扣、车队合同、税和支付意愿均待核。

note.en: Supplier illustration, not a contract. Verify included maintenance, payment processing and the billed energy boundary; do not duplicate covered costs.
note.zh: 供应商示例，非合同。须核维护、支付处理及计量边界，已覆盖费用不得重复计入。

note.en: Unverified lease/insurance/admin/site-cost envelopes. The same monthly allowance is charged during construction; holding-cost NPV is timed at the construction midpoint. No utility fixed charge is separately added to the all-in proxy.
note.zh: 租金/保险/管理/现场成本包尚未验证；建设期也扣同额月费，持有成本按建设中点折现。综合电价代理外不另加电力固定费。

valueOrRange.en: 2% / 1.5% / 1% of initial capex each operating year

note.en: A conservative normalized cash deduction for excluded site assets, not a known maintenance contract or predicted replacement schedule. Reconcile with Tesla coverage before admission.
note.zh: 未覆盖现场资产的标准化现金扣减，非已知维护合同或预测更新计划；入选前须与Tesla服务范围核对。

note.en: No utility/EPC schedule is confirmed. No charging revenue before commissioning. Fixed costs are not reduced by the first-year volume ramp.
note.zh: 尚无电力/工程交期确认，投用前无充电收入；固定成本不随首年销量爬坡同比下降。

note.en: 22kWh is an analogue-informed downside assumption from a 2020–2023 paid non-Tesla DCFC sample, not a local measurement or calibrated percentile. Base/optimistic 40kWh and losses remain assumptions. Grid purchase = billed charger output/(1-loss).
note.zh: 22kWh依据2020–2023年非Tesla付费快充样本设置下行假设，非本地实测或统计分位数。基准/乐观40kWh及损耗仍是假设；购电=充电器计费输出/(1-损耗)。

valueOrRange.en: 10 operating years; 10% real; no growth, subsidy or terminal value
valueOrRange.zh: 10个运营年；10%实际折现率；零增长/补贴/残值

note.en: Chosen screening policy. NREL provides a historical 10-year EVSE modeling precedent, not a V4 life guarantee. A shorter enforceable tenure must shorten the horizon.
note.zh: 选定的筛选规则；NREL历史模型采用10年，但不是V4寿命保证；可执行租期更短时须缩短模型期限。

reason.en: The reference scenarios fail one or more hard payback/NPV/downside-cash tests. This is a failure of the stated assumptions, not proof that the actual parcel must lose money.
reason.zh: 参照情景未通过至少一项回本/NPV/保守现金门槛；这说明该组假设不达标，并非证明真实物业必亏。

note.en: Electricity is conditioned only on the Maine commercial-state benchmark. Same-state results are intentionally identical where no verified property-specific inputs exist. These are conditional calculations for a third-party charging-revenue owner, not Tesla's network costs or host-rent returns.
note.zh: 电价仅按Maine州商业统计作地域条件。在缺少物业独有实测参数时，同州结果有意保持一致，不虚构差异。这是第三方拥有充电收入的条件测算，不代表Tesla内部成本或场地主租金收益。

changeReason.en: Conservative session energy is reduced from 40 to 22 kWh using an older non-Tesla paid-session analogue as a downside assumption. Base and optimistic inputs are unchanged where no defensible site-specific replacement exists. Public tariff sensitivities below are separate incomplete-bill tests.
changeReason.zh: 保守单次电量由40降至22kWh，以较早非Tesla付费样本作下行假设。没有可靠逐址替代值时基准与乐观输入保留。下方公开费率敏感性单独计算，非完整账单。

note.en: EVgo reported 276 kWh/stall/day for its owned public network in Q2 2026. A network-wide average is neither a local demand forecast nor an upper bound. The required volume keeps price and the all-in electricity proxy fixed, so it is a mechanical hurdle test.
note.zh: EVgo报告2026Q2自营公共网络276kWh/枪/日。网络均值不是本站需求预测或上限。门槛销量计算保持售价及综合电费代理不变，仅为数学条件测试。

limitation.en: Retail-unit rent/availability is not EV-land rent/availability; separate parking-right allocation needed.

facts.claim: 业主确认现址40 Jett Ln，营业时间6:00–23:00。
政府商店名单也列明 Walmart #1522 位于40 Jett Ln。

finding.en: Official store #1522 page lists 40 Jett Ln and daily 06:00–23:00.
finding.zh: Walmart #1522 官方页确认 40 Jett Ln，06:00–23:00。

checks.verificationMethod: Opened official page and found the address and store-hours section.
checks.nextEvidence: Parcel identifier, surveyed stalls/entrance and authority to grant charging rights.
checks.significance: The current trading address is supported; proposed stalls and exclusive charging agreements are unknown.

finding.en: Nearest AFDC E record: Elkins Fordland WV (id 322288), 0.308 straight-line miles, 4 DC ports, record last confirmed 2026-10-29. Nearest non-open community record: Bridgeport, WV, PERMIT, 36.971 miles. These are database observations, not a field test.
finding.zh: 已重读冻结 E/P/T 和社区快照：最近 E 记录 322288，直线 0.308 英里；最近社区非开放记录为 PERMIT。仅验证数据库记录。

checks.verificationMethod: Parsed both full AFDC snapshots and community snapshot locally; hashes matched provenance; recomputed haversine distances; inspected nearest rows and all records within 0.25 miles.
checks.nextEvidence: Operator uptime/access/price, permit and energization status, route distances and competitor utilization.
checks.significance: Neither no close match nor low station count proves a vacant parcel or unmet demand.

finding.en: No signed site-control document is present in the reviewed candidate dossier or opened public evidence. Retail operation does not establish charger rights.
finding.zh: 已阅材料无签署场地控制、车位、设备区、通行和租期文件。

checks.verificationMethod: Inspected supplied candidate facts/unknowns and opened primary evidence; no private title search or owner negotiation was performed.
checks.nextEvidence: Owner/landlord authorization, parcel/title and existing charging agreements; rent, term, termination and access rights.
checks.significance: Hard gate fails until evidenced; especially material where tribal or shopping-center rights apply.

finding.en: No site-specific utility capacity letter, connection study, service design, tariff eligibility confirmation or binding upgrade quote was supplied or found in the reviewed material.
finding.zh: 缺本址容量函、接网设计、费用、交期和适用费率确认。

checks.verificationMethod: Evidence inventory review; public business pages and supply snapshots are not connection studies. No utility application or contact made.
checks.nextEvidence: Serving utility confirmation; capacity/load study, transformer/feeder work, deposits, tariff and schedule.
checks.significance: A generic tariff or existing store supply cannot satisfy capacity or connection-cost gates.

finding.en: No parcel-specific Tesla/EPC quotation, civil/electrical design, contingency, commissioning or ongoing service terms are in the reviewed evidence.
finding.zh: 缺本址设备和施工总报价、设计、预备费、投用和服务条款。

checks.verificationMethod: Reviewed supplied retained public-source research and current candidate dossier for quote evidence; historical project costs and marketing estimators are excluded.
checks.nextEvidence: Scoped equipment/EPC quotes including civil work, interconnection, tax, maintenance, insurance and schedule.
checks.significance: Payback cannot be an investment-grade result without documented project costs.

finding.en: No current permit dossier, final inspection, approved stall layout or parcel-specific environmental/engineering clearance is established in the reviewed evidence.
finding.zh: 当前充电许可、验收、停车无障碍布局及地块工程限制尚未证实。

checks.verificationMethod: Public-evidence inventory only; no exhaustive municipal search is claimed. Site-specific exceptions and attempted sources are logged below.
checks.nextEvidence: Current case-level permit record and approved layout; environmental, drainage, access and legal review where applicable.
checks.significance: An absent search hit is not permit clearance; historical approval is not current operational status.

finding.en: No observed site charging sessions/kWh, realized price, queue/diversion study, route EV counts or defensible site capture evidence is available. City registration totals and amenity pages are contextual only.
finding.zh: 缺实测充电销量、成交价、排队/分流、过路 EV 和本址捕获率。

checks.verificationMethod: Reviewed current candidate evidence and frozen supply records; did not convert city EV totals or straight-line gaps into sales.
checks.nextEvidence: Measured representative seasonal demand and competing-site utilization/access, with conservative capture and willingness-to-pay evidence.
checks.significance: Hard gate blocks both network and investor lists, even when a network gap is plausible.

finding.en: A site-specific credible payback is not computable from the reviewed evidence: land, utility, quotes and measured demand are missing. No hurdle pass, profitable outcome or economic failure is established.
finding.zh: 场地、电力、报价及实测需求缺失，不能证明达到回本门槛，也不能据此断言必亏。

checks.verificationMethod: Applied evidence hard gate before scenario ranking; illustrative assumptions are not treated as measured payback.
checks.nextEvidence: Documented cost/revenue inputs, full tariff cash flow, conservative volume, financing/tax assumptions and explicit user-selected hurdle.
checks.significance: Pending; no quota filling and no elimination merely for missing evidence.

reason.en: Required land-control, utility, engineering quote and demand evidence remain missing; investment payback not proven.
reason.zh: 场地控制、电力、工程报价及实测需求均未齐；投资回本未证实，不为凑十个上榜。

attemptedSources.result: Read relevant primary text this round

note.en: EIA commercial revenue/sales average includes demand and fixed charges. This is not an EV tariff or parcel eligibility confirmation.
note.zh: EIA商业电费收入/售电量均值已含需量及固定费；不是EV专用费率，也未确认本地块适用。

note.en: Chosen sensitivity factors, not measured EV bill multipliers. Actual low-utilization bills may be higher. No separate demand charge is added.
note.zh: 人为敏感性参数，不是实测EV电费倍数；低利用率实际账单可能更高，不再单加需量费。

note.en: One supplier example: $500k hardware + 8 × $55k medium installation. Added 35/20/10% allowances are not scoped grid, land, tax or EPC quotes and may be insufficient.
note.zh: 供应商单一示例：硬件50万美元+8×5.5万美元中等安装。35/20/10%预留不是接网、土地、税费或工程报价，可能不足。

note.en: Shared stress inputs. No site demand, capture rate or local achieved volume has been measured. City EV counts are not converted into sales.
note.zh: 共用压力输入，尚无本站需求、捕获率或实际销量；没有把城市EV数量换算成收入。

note.en: Chosen prices, not local observations. Discounts, fleet contracts, taxes and willingness to pay require evidence.
note.zh: 人为设置，非本地成交观察；折扣、车队合同、税和支付意愿均待核。

note.en: Supplier illustration, not a contract. Verify included maintenance, payment processing and the billed energy boundary; do not duplicate covered costs.
note.zh: 供应商示例，非合同。须核维护、支付处理及计量边界，已覆盖费用不得重复计入。

note.en: Unverified lease/insurance/admin/site-cost envelopes. The same monthly allowance is charged during construction; holding-cost NPV is timed at the construction midpoint. No utility fixed charge is separately added to the all-in proxy.
note.zh: 租金/保险/管理/现场成本包尚未验证；建设期也扣同额月费，持有成本按建设中点折现。综合电价代理外不另加电力固定费。

valueOrRange.en: 2% / 1.5% / 1% of initial capex each operating year

note.en: A conservative normalized cash deduction for excluded site assets, not a known maintenance contract or predicted replacement schedule. Reconcile with Tesla coverage before admission.
note.zh: 未覆盖现场资产的标准化现金扣减，非已知维护合同或预测更新计划；入选前须与Tesla服务范围核对。

note.en: No utility/EPC schedule is confirmed. No charging revenue before commissioning. Fixed costs are not reduced by the first-year volume ramp.
note.zh: 尚无电力/工程交期确认，投用前无充电收入；固定成本不随首年销量爬坡同比下降。

note.en: 22kWh is an analogue-informed downside assumption from a 2020–2023 paid non-Tesla DCFC sample, not a local measurement or calibrated percentile. Base/optimistic 40kWh and losses remain assumptions. Grid purchase = billed charger output/(1-loss).
note.zh: 22kWh依据2020–2023年非Tesla付费快充样本设置下行假设，非本地实测或统计分位数。基准/乐观40kWh及损耗仍是假设；购电=充电器计费输出/(1-损耗)。

valueOrRange.en: 10 operating years; 10% real; no growth, subsidy or terminal value
valueOrRange.zh: 10个运营年；10%实际折现率；零增长/补贴/残值

note.en: Chosen screening policy. NREL provides a historical 10-year EVSE modeling precedent, not a V4 life guarantee. A shorter enforceable tenure must shorten the horizon.
note.zh: 选定的筛选规则；NREL历史模型采用10年，但不是V4寿命保证；可执行租期更短时须缩短模型期限。

reason.en: The reference scenarios fail one or more hard payback/NPV/downside-cash tests. This is a failure of the stated assumptions, not proof that the actual parcel must lose money.
reason.zh: 参照情景未通过至少一项回本/NPV/保守现金门槛；这说明该组假设不达标，并非证明真实物业必亏。

note.en: Electricity is conditioned only on the Arkansas commercial-state benchmark. Same-state results are intentionally identical where no verified property-specific inputs exist. These are conditional calculations for a third-party charging-revenue owner, not Tesla's network costs or host-rent returns.
note.zh: 电价仅按Arkansas州商业统计作地域条件。在缺少物业独有实测参数时，同州结果有意保持一致，不虚构差异。这是第三方拥有充电收入的条件测算，不代表Tesla内部成本或场地主租金收益。

changeReason.en: Conservative session energy is reduced from 40 to 22 kWh using an older non-Tesla paid-session analogue as a downside assumption. Base and optimistic inputs are unchanged where no defensible site-specific replacement exists. Public tariff sensitivities below are separate incomplete-bill tests.
changeReason.zh: 保守单次电量由40降至22kWh，以较早非Tesla付费样本作下行假设。没有可靠逐址替代值时基准与乐观输入保留。下方公开费率敏感性单独计算，非完整账单。

note.en: EVgo reported 276 kWh/stall/day for its owned public network in Q2 2026. A network-wide average is neither a local demand forecast nor an upper bound. The required volume keeps price and the all-in electricity proxy fixed, so it is a mechanical hurdle test.
note.zh: EVgo报告2026Q2自营公共网络276kWh/枪/日。网络均值不是本站需求预测或上限。门槛销量计算保持售价及综合电费代理不变，仅为数学条件测试。

finding.en: No parcel-specific Tesla/EPC quotation, civil/electrical design, contingency, commissioning or ongoing service terms are in the reviewed evidence.

checks.verificationMethod: Reviewed supplied retained public-source research and current candidate dossier for quote evidence; historical project costs and marketing estimators are excluded.
checks.nextEvidence: Scoped equipment/EPC quotes including civil work, interconnection, tax, maintenance, insurance and schedule.
checks.significance: Payback cannot be an investment-grade result without documented project costs.

finding.en: No current permit dossier, final inspection, approved stall layout or parcel-specific environmental/engineering clearance is established in the reviewed evidence.

checks.verificationMethod: Public-evidence inventory only; no exhaustive municipal search is claimed. Site-specific exceptions and attempted sources are logged below.
checks.nextEvidence: Current case-level permit record and approved layout; environmental, drainage, access and legal review where applicable.
checks.significance: An absent search hit is not permit clearance; historical approval is not current operational status.

finding.en: No observed site charging sessions/kWh, realized price, queue/diversion study, route EV counts or defensible site capture evidence is available. City registration totals and amenity pages are contextual only.
finding.zh: 缺实测充电销量、成交价、排队/分流、过路 EV 和本址捕获率。

checks.verificationMethod: Reviewed current candidate evidence and frozen supply records; did not convert city EV totals or straight-line gaps into sales.
checks.nextEvidence: Measured representative seasonal demand and competing-site utilization/access, with conservative capture and willingness-to-pay evidence.
checks.significance: Hard gate blocks both network and investor lists, even when a network gap is plausible.

finding.en: A site-specific credible payback is not computable from the reviewed evidence: land, utility, quotes and measured demand are missing. No hurdle pass, profitable outcome or economic failure is established.
finding.zh: 场地、电力、报价及实测需求缺失，不能证明达到回本门槛，也不能据此断言必亏。

checks.verificationMethod: Applied evidence hard gate before scenario ranking; illustrative assumptions are not treated as measured payback.
checks.nextEvidence: Documented cost/revenue inputs, full tariff cash flow, conservative volume, financing/tax assumptions and explicit user-selected hurdle.
checks.significance: Pending; no quota filling and no elimination merely for missing evidence.

finding.zh: AFDC 164017 与州旅游页确认 16 Main St 已有设备；历史州报告用 30 Main St，须核对地址别名。

checks.verificationMethod: Opened tourism page; inspected frozen AFDC exact-address record; reread supplied official PDF page-21 extraction.
checks.nextEvidence: Existing asset ownership, exact parcel/address, condition, operator contract and incremental upgrade scope.
checks.significance: Reject unequipped-greenfield framing; investment option remains pending as an upgrade/partnership.

checks.verificationMethod: Reread supplied official PDF page-296 extraction; historical source retained without claiming live refresh.
checks.nextEvidence: Current utility application, scope, funding reservation and executed cost allocation.
checks.significance: Existing upgrade activity may supersede a new independent project; no historical grant assumed.

note.en: EIA commercial revenue/sales average includes demand and fixed charges. This is not an EV tariff or parcel eligibility confirmation.
note.zh: EIA商业电费收入/售电量均值已含需量及固定费；不是EV专用费率，也未确认本地块适用。

note.en: Chosen sensitivity factors, not measured EV bill multipliers. Actual low-utilization bills may be higher. No separate demand charge is added.
note.zh: 人为敏感性参数，不是实测EV电费倍数；低利用率实际账单可能更高，不再单加需量费。

note.en: One supplier example: $500k hardware + 8 × $55k medium installation. Added 35/20/10% allowances are not scoped grid, land, tax or EPC quotes and may be insufficient.
note.zh: 供应商单一示例：硬件50万美元+8×5.5万美元中等安装。35/20/10%预留不是接网、土地、税费或工程报价，可能不足。

note.en: Shared stress inputs. No site demand, capture rate or local achieved volume has been measured. City EV counts are not converted into sales.
note.zh: 共用压力输入，尚无本站需求、捕获率或实际销量；没有把城市EV数量换算成收入。

note.en: Chosen prices, not local observations. Discounts, fleet contracts, taxes and willingness to pay require evidence.
note.zh: 人为设置，非本地成交观察；折扣、车队合同、税和支付意愿均待核。

note.en: Supplier illustration, not a contract. Verify included maintenance, payment processing and the billed energy boundary; do not duplicate covered costs.
note.zh: 供应商示例，非合同。须核维护、支付处理及计量边界，已覆盖费用不得重复计入。

note.en: Unverified lease/insurance/admin/site-cost envelopes. The same monthly allowance is charged during construction; holding-cost NPV is timed at the construction midpoint. No utility fixed charge is separately added to the all-in proxy.
note.zh: 租金/保险/管理/现场成本包尚未验证；建设期也扣同额月费，持有成本按建设中点折现。综合电价代理外不另加电力固定费。

valueOrRange.en: 2% / 1.5% / 1% of initial capex each operating year

note.en: A conservative normalized cash deduction for excluded site assets, not a known maintenance contract or predicted replacement schedule. Reconcile with Tesla coverage before admission.
note.zh: 未覆盖现场资产的标准化现金扣减，非已知维护合同或预测更新计划；入选前须与Tesla服务范围核对。

note.en: No utility/EPC schedule is confirmed. No charging revenue before commissioning. Fixed costs are not reduced by the first-year volume ramp.
note.zh: 尚无电力/工程交期确认，投用前无充电收入；固定成本不随首年销量爬坡同比下降。

note.en: 22kWh is an analogue-informed downside assumption from a 2020–2023 paid non-Tesla DCFC sample, not a local measurement or calibrated percentile. Base/optimistic 40kWh and losses remain assumptions. Grid purchase = billed charger output/(1-loss).
note.zh: 22kWh依据2020–2023年非Tesla付费快充样本设置下行假设，非本地实测或统计分位数。基准/乐观40kWh及损耗仍是假设；购电=充电器计费输出/(1-损耗)。

valueOrRange.en: 10 operating years; 10% real; no growth, subsidy or terminal value
valueOrRange.zh: 10个运营年；10%实际折现率；零增长/补贴/残值

note.en: Chosen screening policy. NREL provides a historical 10-year EVSE modeling precedent, not a V4 life guarantee. A shorter enforceable tenure must shorten the horizon.
note.zh: 选定的筛选规则；NREL历史模型采用10年，但不是V4寿命保证；可执行租期更短时须缩短模型期限。

reason.en: The reference scenarios fail one or more hard payback/NPV/downside-cash tests. This is a failure of the stated assumptions, not proof that the actual parcel must lose money.
reason.zh: 参照情景未通过至少一项回本/NPV/保守现金门槛；这说明该组假设不达标，并非证明真实物业必亏。

note.en: Electricity is conditioned only on the Nevada commercial-state benchmark. Same-state results are intentionally identical where no verified property-specific inputs exist. These are conditional calculations for a third-party charging-revenue owner, not Tesla's network costs or host-rent returns.
note.zh: 电价仅按Nevada州商业统计作地域条件。在缺少物业独有实测参数时，同州结果有意保持一致，不虚构差异。这是第三方拥有充电收入的条件测算，不代表Tesla内部成本或场地主租金收益。

changeReason.en: Conservative session energy is reduced from 40 to 22 kWh using an older non-Tesla paid-session analogue as a downside assumption. Base and optimistic inputs are unchanged where no defensible site-specific replacement exists. Public tariff sensitivities below are separate incomplete-bill tests.
changeReason.zh: 保守单次电量由40降至22kWh，以较早非Tesla付费样本作下行假设。没有可靠逐址替代值时基准与乐观输入保留。下方公开费率敏感性单独计算，非完整账单。

note.en: EVgo reported 276 kWh/stall/day for its owned public network in Q2 2026. A network-wide average is neither a local demand forecast nor an upper bound. The required volume keeps price and the all-in electricity proxy fixed, so it is a mechanical hurdle test.
note.zh: EVgo报告2026Q2自营公共网络276kWh/枪/日。网络均值不是本站需求预测或上限。门槛销量计算保持售价及综合电费代理不变，仅为数学条件测试。

claim.en: Champ’sRewards developer identifies Champs Fuel, Inc. at16 Main Street,Austin.
claim.zh: Champ’sRewards开发者列ChampsFuel,Inc.地址为Austin的16MainStreet。

limitation.en: Self-declared business address is not title and does not resolve historical 30 Main construction footprint.
limitation.zh: 自报营业地址非产权，不能解决历史30Main工程边界。

claim.en: A May 2026 case study reports two 50kW Austin chargers working on an early-May trip at quoted retail$0.95/kWh.
claim.zh: 2026年5月案例称5月初旅途中Austin两台50kW桩可用，零售报价$0.95/kWh。

limitation.en: Competitor-published travel observation, not live operator status, annual uptime or demand. Price not adopted as future revenue.
limitation.zh: 竞争方旅行观察，不是实时运营、全年可用率或需求；不作未来收入价。

remainingCritical.en: Executed charger lease/easements, signatory authority, exclusivity and 24-hour public-access rights remain unverified.
remainingCritical.zh: 充电租约、地役权、签署权限、排他条款及24小时公众通行权未核实。

remainingCritical.en: No parcel-specific firm capacity, connection scope/date or utility construction quote was obtained.
remainingCritical.zh: 未取得地块级确定容量、接入范围/日期或供电施工报价。

remainingCritical.en: Final engineering, permit clearance, complete EPC cost and lifecycle operating terms remain unverified.
remainingCritical.zh: 最终设计、许可、完整EPC造价及全生命周期运营条款未核实。

remainingCritical.en: No observed site charging revenue/utilization or defensible traffic-to-session conversion was obtained.
remainingCritical.zh: 未取得场地实测充电收入/利用率或可验证车流转充电次数关系。

changesToPrior.en: Added corporate-address corroboration and dated secondary operations observation.
changesToPrior.zh: 新增公司地址旁证及有日期次级运行观察。

publicResearchConclusion.en: Remains existing-charging upgrade/co-location, not demonstrated unmet greenfield demand.
publicResearchConclusion.zh: 仍属既有充电提升或共址，未证明空白新建需求。

No new approved2025/26 parcel upgrade established beyond prior IRP discussion.

facts.claim: 官方物业名称与邮政地址；营业时间 24小时
官方按地址城市 Vancouver 汇总：纯电动车 8632 辆、插混 2675 辆；不代表物业商圈。
Schedule134次级供电列明能量费0.05美元/kWh、需量费9.29美元/kW·月、基本费58美元/月；15分钟需量，功率因数低于95%调整。适用资格及转售须批准，本地块适用性未核。

finding.en: Official store #72 lists 11310 NE 119th St and 24-hour store operation.
finding.zh: WinCo #72 官方页确认地址及全天营业。

checks.verificationMethod: Opened official store detail page and read address/hours.
checks.nextEvidence: Parcel identifier, surveyed stalls/entrance and authority to grant charging rights.
checks.significance: Nearby existing DCFC creates an incremental-demand question.

finding.en: Nearest AFDC E record: ARCO NE 119th Street, Vancouver, WA (id 323778), 0.215 straight-line miles, 4 DC ports, record last confirmed 2026-10-29. Nearest non-open community record: Vancouver, WA - NE Hwy 99, CONSTRUCTION, 4.971 miles. These are database observations, not a field test.
finding.zh: 已重读冻结 E/P/T 和社区快照：最近 E 记录 323778，直线 0.215 英里；最近社区非开放记录为 CONSTRUCTION。仅验证数据库记录。

checks.verificationMethod: Parsed both full AFDC snapshots and community snapshot locally; hashes matched provenance; recomputed haversine distances; inspected nearest rows and all records within 0.25 miles.
checks.nextEvidence: Operator uptime/access/price, permit and energization status, route distances and competitor utilization.
checks.significance: Neither no close match nor low station count proves a vacant parcel or unmet demand.

finding.en: No signed site-control document is present in the reviewed candidate dossier or opened public evidence. Retail operation does not establish charger rights.
finding.zh: 已阅材料无签署场地控制、车位、设备区、通行和租期文件。

checks.verificationMethod: Inspected supplied candidate facts/unknowns and opened primary evidence; no private title search or owner negotiation was performed.
checks.nextEvidence: Owner/landlord authorization, parcel/title and existing charging agreements; rent, term, termination and access rights.
checks.significance: Hard gate fails until evidenced; especially material where tribal or shopping-center rights apply.

finding.en: No site-specific utility capacity letter, connection study, service design, tariff eligibility confirmation or binding upgrade quote was supplied or found in the reviewed material.
finding.zh: 缺本址容量函、接网设计、费用、交期和适用费率确认。

checks.verificationMethod: Evidence inventory review; public business pages and supply snapshots are not connection studies. No utility application or contact made.
checks.nextEvidence: Serving utility confirmation; capacity/load study, transformer/feeder work, deposits, tariff and schedule.
checks.significance: A generic tariff or existing store supply cannot satisfy capacity or connection-cost gates.

finding.en: No parcel-specific Tesla/EPC quotation, civil/electrical design, contingency, commissioning or ongoing service terms are in the reviewed evidence.
finding.zh: 缺本址设备和施工总报价、设计、预备费、投用和服务条款。

checks.verificationMethod: Reviewed supplied retained public-source research and current candidate dossier for quote evidence; historical project costs and marketing estimators are excluded.
checks.nextEvidence: Scoped equipment/EPC quotes including civil work, interconnection, tax, maintenance, insurance and schedule.
checks.significance: Payback cannot be an investment-grade result without documented project costs.

finding.en: No current permit dossier, final inspection, approved stall layout or parcel-specific environmental/engineering clearance is established in the reviewed evidence.
finding.zh: 当前充电许可、验收、停车无障碍布局及地块工程限制尚未证实。

checks.verificationMethod: Public-evidence inventory only; no exhaustive municipal search is claimed. Site-specific exceptions and attempted sources are logged below.
checks.nextEvidence: Current case-level permit record and approved layout; environmental, drainage, access and legal review where applicable.
checks.significance: An absent search hit is not permit clearance; historical approval is not current operational status.

finding.en: No observed site charging sessions/kWh, realized price, queue/diversion study, route EV counts or defensible site capture evidence is available. City registration totals and amenity pages are contextual only.
finding.zh: 缺实测充电销量、成交价、排队/分流、过路 EV 和本址捕获率。

checks.verificationMethod: Reviewed current candidate evidence and frozen supply records; did not convert city EV totals or straight-line gaps into sales.
checks.nextEvidence: Measured representative seasonal demand and competing-site utilization/access, with conservative capture and willingness-to-pay evidence.
checks.significance: Hard gate blocks both network and investor lists, even when a network gap is plausible.

finding.en: A site-specific credible payback is not computable from the reviewed evidence: land, utility, quotes and measured demand are missing. No hurdle pass, profitable outcome or economic failure is established.
finding.zh: 场地、电力、报价及实测需求缺失，不能证明达到回本门槛，也不能据此断言必亏。

checks.verificationMethod: Applied evidence hard gate before scenario ranking; illustrative assumptions are not treated as measured payback.
checks.nextEvidence: Documented cost/revenue inputs, full tariff cash flow, conservative volume, financing/tax assumptions and explicit user-selected hurdle.
checks.significance: Pending; no quota filling and no elimination merely for missing evidence.

finding.en: Clark’s published commercial rates include demand-metering rules and require utility approval for energy resale. Parcel eligibility and applicable service class are not established.
finding.zh: Clark 正式费率包含需量计费和转售审批条件；本址类别/资格仍未知。

checks.verificationMethod: Opened official current rates and read commercial demand / Schedule 34 applicability.
checks.nextEvidence: Utility confirmation of tariff, resale approval and complete interval-load bill model.
checks.significance: Do not model residential cents/kWh as the whole DCFC bill.

reason.en: Required land-control, utility, engineering quote and demand evidence remain missing; investment payback not proven.
reason.zh: 场地控制、电力、工程报价及实测需求均未齐；投资回本未证实，不为凑十个上榜。

attemptedSources.result: Read relevant primary text this round

attemptedSources.method: Opened official current rates and read commercial demand / Schedule 34 applicability.
attemptedSources.result: verified

note.en: EIA commercial revenue/sales average includes demand and fixed charges. This is not an EV tariff or parcel eligibility confirmation.
note.zh: EIA商业电费收入/售电量均值已含需量及固定费；不是EV专用费率，也未确认本地块适用。

note.en: Chosen sensitivity factors, not measured EV bill multipliers. Actual low-utilization bills may be higher. No separate demand charge is added.
note.zh: 人为敏感性参数，不是实测EV电费倍数；低利用率实际账单可能更高，不再单加需量费。

note.en: One supplier example: $500k hardware + 8 × $55k medium installation. Added 35/20/10% allowances are not scoped grid, land, tax or EPC quotes and may be insufficient.
note.zh: 供应商单一示例：硬件50万美元+8×5.5万美元中等安装。35/20/10%预留不是接网、土地、税费或工程报价，可能不足。

note.en: Shared stress inputs. No site demand, capture rate or local achieved volume has been measured. City EV counts are not converted into sales.
note.zh: 共用压力输入，尚无本站需求、捕获率或实际销量；没有把城市EV数量换算成收入。

note.en: Chosen prices, not local observations. Discounts, fleet contracts, taxes and willingness to pay require evidence.
note.zh: 人为设置，非本地成交观察；折扣、车队合同、税和支付意愿均待核。

note.en: Supplier illustration, not a contract. Verify included maintenance, payment processing and the billed energy boundary; do not duplicate covered costs.
note.zh: 供应商示例，非合同。须核维护、支付处理及计量边界，已覆盖费用不得重复计入。

note.en: Unverified lease/insurance/admin/site-cost envelopes. The same monthly allowance is charged during construction; holding-cost NPV is timed at the construction midpoint. No utility fixed charge is separately added to the all-in proxy.
note.zh: 租金/保险/管理/现场成本包尚未验证；建设期也扣同额月费，持有成本按建设中点折现。综合电价代理外不另加电力固定费。

valueOrRange.en: 2% / 1.5% / 1% of initial capex each operating year

note.en: A conservative normalized cash deduction for excluded site assets, not a known maintenance contract or predicted replacement schedule. Reconcile with Tesla coverage before admission.
note.zh: 未覆盖现场资产的标准化现金扣减，非已知维护合同或预测更新计划；入选前须与Tesla服务范围核对。

note.en: No utility/EPC schedule is confirmed. No charging revenue before commissioning. Fixed costs are not reduced by the first-year volume ramp.
note.zh: 尚无电力/工程交期确认，投用前无充电收入；固定成本不随首年销量爬坡同比下降。

note.en: 22kWh is an analogue-informed downside assumption from a 2020–2023 paid non-Tesla DCFC sample, not a local measurement or calibrated percentile. Base/optimistic 40kWh and losses remain assumptions. Grid purchase = billed charger output/(1-loss).
note.zh: 22kWh依据2020–2023年非Tesla付费快充样本设置下行假设，非本地实测或统计分位数。基准/乐观40kWh及损耗仍是假设；购电=充电器计费输出/(1-损耗)。

valueOrRange.en: 10 operating years; 10% real; no growth, subsidy or terminal value
valueOrRange.zh: 10个运营年；10%实际折现率；零增长/补贴/残值

note.en: Chosen screening policy. NREL provides a historical 10-year EVSE modeling precedent, not a V4 life guarantee. A shorter enforceable tenure must shorten the horizon.
note.zh: 选定的筛选规则；NREL历史模型采用10年，但不是V4寿命保证；可执行租期更短时须缩短模型期限。

reason.en: The reference scenarios fail one or more hard payback/NPV/downside-cash tests. This is a failure of the stated assumptions, not proof that the actual parcel must lose money.
reason.zh: 参照情景未通过至少一项回本/NPV/保守现金门槛；这说明该组假设不达标，并非证明真实物业必亏。

note.en: Electricity is conditioned only on the Washington commercial-state benchmark. Same-state results are intentionally identical where no verified property-specific inputs exist. These are conditional calculations for a third-party charging-revenue owner, not Tesla's network costs or host-rent returns.
note.zh: 电价仅按Washington州商业统计作地域条件。在缺少物业独有实测参数时，同州结果有意保持一致，不虚构差异。这是第三方拥有充电收入的条件测算，不代表Tesla内部成本或场地主租金收益。

changeReason.en: Conservative session energy is reduced from 40 to 22 kWh using an older non-Tesla paid-session analogue as a downside assumption. Base and optimistic inputs are unchanged where no defensible site-specific replacement exists. Public tariff sensitivities below are separate incomplete-bill tests.
changeReason.zh: 保守单次电量由40降至22kWh，以较早非Tesla付费样本作下行假设。没有可靠逐址替代值时基准与乐观输入保留。下方公开费率敏感性单独计算，非完整账单。

note.en: EVgo reported 276 kWh/stall/day for its owned public network in Q2 2026. A network-wide average is neither a local demand forecast nor an upper bound. The required volume keeps price and the all-in electricity proxy fixed, so it is a mechanical hurdle test.
note.zh: EVgo报告2026Q2自营公共网络276kWh/枪/日。网络均值不是本站需求预测或上限。门槛销量计算保持售价及综合电费代理不变，仅为数学条件测试。

limitation.en: Posted secondary-service charges; assumes this separately metered EV load qualifies (>=100kW for at least 3 months/year). Assumed monthly peaks: 1200/500/300kW. Excludes power-factor surcharge, possible taxes and connection contributions; resale approval and parcel eligibility unconfirmed. Rates held constant in real terms, not a forecast.
limitation.zh: 已公布低压服务费用；假设该独立计量EV负荷适用（至少每年3个月>=100kW）。假设计费峰值1200/500/300kW；未计功率因数附加、可能税费及接网分摊，转售许可及本站适用性未确认。费率按实际购买力固定，非预测。

claim.en: Clark explicitly supplies all Clark County, strengthening the verified Vancouver address linkage.
claim.zh: Clark明确向整个克拉克县供电，增强已核实温哥华地址的供电归属判断。

limitation.en: Territory is supported; meter, capacity, quote and energization date remain unconfirmed.
limitation.zh: 区域归属有支持；电表、容量、报价与送电日期仍未确认。

claim.en: Schedule 134 resale requires utility approval; customer contributions may apply to new connection work.
claim.zh: 134号费率下转售电力须取得公用事业批准；新接入工程可能须客户出资。

limitation.en: Published terms are not an approved charging account or complete bill.
limitation.zh: 公开条款不是已批准的充电账户或完整账单。

claim.en: WinCo described this store as approximately 94,000 square feet in its March 2010 opening release.
claim.zh: WinCo在2010年3月开业公告称该店约94,000平方英尺。

limitation.en: Historical company statement; not current title or available parking area.
limitation.zh: 历史企业声明，不是当前产权或可用停车面积。

remainingCritical.en: Executed landlord/tenant parking rights, rent, exclusivity and term.
remainingCritical.zh: 已签业主/租户停车权、租金、独家限制及期限。

remainingCritical.en: Point of delivery, available grid capacity, full tariff, connection quote and date.
remainingCritical.zh: 接入点、电力余量、完整费率、接入报价及日期。

remainingCritical.en: EV-specific engineering, permits, environmental constraints and complete EPC quote.
remainingCritical.zh: 充电站专用工程、许可、环境约束及完整EPC报价。

remainingCritical.en: Measured paid demand, competing utilization and realizable selling prices.
remainingCritical.zh: 实测付费需求、竞争站利用率及可实现售价。

changesToPrior.en: Source-qualified findings added; no site-control, capacity, cost or demand gate is promoted to verified.
changesToPrior.zh: 补充分类证据；不将场地控制、容量、成本或需求门槛提升为已核实。

publicResearchConclusion.en: Pending. Utility territory and published charges are better supported. Conditional tariff costs improve base cash versus the state proxy, but payback and evidence gates still fail.
publicResearchConclusion.zh: 待核。供电区域及公布收费依据增强；条件费率下基准现金优于州均价代理，但回本与证据门槛仍未通过。
